definition: Two proposed Boolean sublanguages of the existing VerdictSilent.twoCoordinate comparison language. Empirical membership is invariance under the second coordinate, computed by two Boolean equalities; expanded admits all ambient contents. encode retains one or two independent Boolean coordinates; channels is their count (1 or 2), an explicit pragmatic complexity measure. This models the declared reconstruction only, not Carnap’s complete philosophy.
